title: Fix the Switch Fall-Through
description: The program should print the name of a day of the week based on a number.
expectedBehavior: For day = 2, the program should print only 'Tuesday'.
actualProblem: None of the cases end with a break statement, so once execution matches case 2, it 'falls through' and keeps running the code for case 3 and default too, printing three lines instead of one.
explanation: Without a break, Java's switch statement continues executing every subsequent case's code regardless of its label, until it hits a break or the end of the switch. Adding break after each case's logic stops this fall-through.
